hints.title: Comment Mode State
hints.text: Maintain a boolean state variable indicating whether the parser is currently inside a multiline block comment.

hints.title: Comment Delimiter Parsing
hints.text: When outside block comment mode, check for the start of line comments or block comments. When inside block comment mode, search only for the closing delimiter.

hints.title: Line Buffer Accumulation
hints.text: Accumulate characters outside of comment sections into a line buffer. Only append non-empty line buffers to the final result when not currently trapped inside an active block comment across lines.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: L: total number of characters in source code
complexity.notes: Single pass linear scanning maintaining block comment parsing state.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Regular expressions struggle to maintain cross-line state and comment precedence correctly.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Buffering characters in a single output array runs in linear time with minimal memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handle multi-line comments that start and end on different lines, and only flush non-empty lines when outside block comments.
